passages.text:
Re: Time to chat with USAID re: COVID response?
[contact omitted] Rahima Dosani Tuesday, June 8, 2021 at 4:19:22 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Stephanie Sasser
Cc: [contact omitted] Rachel Wood
Hi Stephanie,
Thanks for the response. We were going to see if any Missions were interested in FB's capabilities to further their COVID
response -is that something we still should pursue, or would you prefer us not to given your lack of inbound request
options? Would love your thoughts.
Thanks,
Rahima
On Mon, Jun 7, 2021 at 4:19 PM Stephanie Sasser { [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks Rahima. Most of the solutions in this doc are either handled onour side e.g. pulling content from health
authorities into the COVID Info Center, or are self-serve e.g. governments using the WhatsApp APl to build chatbots.
So there isn't much that requires direct coordination with a team at FB other than receiving ad credits, though
Hope this helps!
Stephanie
From: Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, June 7, 2021 3:11 PM
To: Stephanie Sasser & [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Rachel Wood <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Time to chat with USAID re: COVID response?
Hi Stephanie,
I made your requested changes; thanks again for reviewing the document. Just to clarify, when you say that FB doesn't
have a mechanism for inbound country requests, is there a plan to change that? Or is there another way that countries
can engage with FB? On our call you mentioned an interest to engage with public sector partners, so just curious.
Also, does FB have any interest or plans to match funds for governments wanting to do this type of work? Really
appreciate your time and answers in all of this!
Best,
Rahima
On Mon, Jun 7, 2021 at 1:44 PM Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]> wrote:

Thanks so much for your edits! I will remove the sections you mentioned and accept your changes. We'll just be
sharing this internally to some USAID Missions who express interest in this type of work. Does that work?
On Mon, Jun 7, 2021 at 1:38 PM Stephanie Sasser • [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Rahima,
Thanks for following up. I dropped a bunch of edits and comments in the doc. Let me know if you have any
questions.
Additionally, can you share how this concept note will be used?
Thanks,
Stephanie
From: Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, June 1, 2021 1:25 PM
To: Stephanie Sasser < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Rachel Wood <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Time to chat with USAID re: COVID response?
Hi Stephanie,
Hope you had a great long weekend -just wanted to bring this to the top of your inbox to see if you could take a
super quick look for accuracy. Many thanks again.
Best,
Rahima
On Wed, May 26, 2021 at 1:44 PM Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Stephanie,
Thanks again for your generous time the other day! In any future conversations we have with USAID Missions
that might be interested in FB's capabilities to help combat the COVID response, we put together a brief
concept note to outline the capabilities. Would you mind taking a quick look and editing for accuracy? Want to
make sure we are accurately representing your tools and programs.
Many thanks for your help -

Best,
Rahima
On Fri, May 21, 2021 at 1:20 PM Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Stephanie,
It was really wonderful to connect with you, thank you so much again for your time! This is super helpful and
we'll be in touch as we develop our concept note for Facebook. Look forward to hopefully collaborating in the
future.
Warmly,
Rahima
On Thu, May 20, 2021 at 2:49 PM Stephanie Sasser < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Rahima and Rachel,
Great connecting with you! Here's the website I mentioned for governments. It doesn't have our full set of
offerings but hopefully is a helpful starting point: [link omitted]
Also note this document with some results from COVID ad campaigns
Best,
Stephanie
From: Stephanie Sasser
Sent: Tuesday, May 18, 2021 10:06 AM
To: Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Nikki Tyler <[contact omitted]>; Rachel Wood <[contact omitted]>
Subject: RE: Time to chat with USAID re: COVID response?
Great, thanks Rahima. Talk soon.
From: Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, May 18, 2021 9:29 AM
To: Stephanie Sasser < [opaque block]
Cc: Nikki Tyler <[contact omitted]>; Rachel Wood <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Time to chat with USAID re: COVID response?
Hi Stephanie,

Thanks so much for the links. 2pm on Thurs works well for us; will send out an invite.
Many thanks,
Rahima
On Mon, May 17, 2021 at 9:35 PM Stephanie Sasser < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Nikki and Rahima,
Hope you're both doing well, and thanks for reaching out! I'd be happy to set up some time to discuss
how we might work together on these areas. Would this Thursday at 2:00 or 2:30 ET work for you?
Otherwise Monday 5/24 is pretty open.
If you haven't already, you might want to check out some of the posts we ve put out about the
company's COVID/vaccine-related work. This is certainly not exhaustive but might help give a sense of
where we're focused:
• Supporting Vaccination Efforts on Our Apps
• Supporting Equitable Access to COVID Vaccines
Keeping People Safe & Informed About Coronavirus - this is sort of a running list of
various initiatives from 2020
Best,
Stephanie
From: Nikki Tyler <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, May 13, 2021 8:45 PM
To: Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Stephanie Sasser < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Rachel Wood <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Time to chat with USAID re: COVID response?
Would be great to catch-up, Stephanie -- it's been awhile! Hope all is well. Thanks, Nikki
On Thu, May 13, 2021 at 8:23 PM Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Stephanie,
Hope you're doing well! I wanted to circle back and see if you might be able to spare 30 mins for a
quick chat with USAID - please let me know, and thanks for considering.
Best,
Rahima

On Thu, May 6, 2021 at 3:38 PM Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Stephanie,
I hope this message finds you well! My name is Rahima and I work with Nikki Tyler at USAID's
Bureau for Global Health, in the Center for Innovation and Impact.
Along with my colleague Rachel Wood, we are conducting exploratory market
research conversations to understand how large tech companies can leverage their network,
reach, resources, and social influence to improve the COVID response in low-and-middle income
countries. We've thought through a few areas of interest, such as combatting COVID mis/dis
information, reducing vaccine hesitancy and generating demand, and leveraging in-country
employer infrastructure to provide additional sites for COVID testing or vaccination.
Would you be interested in a 30-minute discussion to explore how FB or WhatsApp are
engaging in the COVID response and potential partnership opportunities? Please let us know it
so, and l can share some potential times to discuss.
Many thanks for considering,
Rahima
-
Rahima F. Dosani, MBA, MPH (she/her)
